name: Lost Shipping Crate
summary: A shipping crate marked for Friz Frazzlespark has gone missing in the Riverglades. Its label asks that it be returned to Powderfuse Port.

sections.title: A Marked Crate
sections.body: Friz Frazzlespark's crate bears a handwritten label naming Powderfuse Port in the Riverglades. A map marks a southeastern shore north of a water-surrounded temple, with winged creatures nearby. The label warns against opening the crate without supervision, and names Friz as the person to receive it.

faq.answer: The label names Friz Frazzlespark as the crate's owner.

faq.q: Where should I take the crate?
faq.answer: The label says to return the crate to Friz Frazzlespark at Powderfuse Port in the Riverglades.

faq.q: What does the crate's label say?
faq.answer: It identifies Friz Frazzlespark and Powderfuse Port, warns against opening the crate without supervision, and gives a return location in the Riverglades.

faq.q: Is the crate safe to open?
faq.answer: The label says not to open it without supervision.
